title: Palantir and NVIDIA Team to Deliver Sovereign AI Operating System Reference Architecture

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What might a sovereign AI operating system mean for global data governance and AI sovereignty?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Palantir and NVIDIA are integrating secure, scalable AI with hardware-software co-design for enterprise sovereignty.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Centralized control risks reinforcing power imbalances and undermining data privacy in the hands of a few.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source modules and modular architecture let users customize and audit the system for transparency.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With global collaboration, this could enable equitable AI development and localized data ownership.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future may see sovereign AI systems as a bridge between innovation and ethical global governance.

video_cue: A secure data center with AI modules being integrated into a global network, emphasizing transparency and control.
